narrative.overview:
Milvayo is calm, exact and dependable. Neutral graphite planes, clear sans typography and compact controls frame the work; analytical graphics, the agenda, Timeline and Kanban provide the visual richness. Keep the original Milvayo Board mark and one personal accent. Give each workflow a composition suited to its job, with current work and a clear next action before advanced controls.

Motion is plentiful where it explains an action: press feedback, date selection, chart inspection, numeric change, sheet arrival and Kanban lift/reflow. Keep it bounded, interruptible and sensitive to reduced motion. Continuous gestures follow the finger directly.

Interaction follow-up: task description follows title; destructive/copy confirmations stay in the same popup and copies keep context. Home dates swipe between bounded weeks without chevrons, with accessible week actions. More owns Manage tools; Board header owns filters. Held Kanban lists stack above the ribbon without changing their lift animation. See docs/qa/redesign-063/popup-nav-warning-followup.md for source checks and device limits.

Task description editing uses a theme-accent SVG check to save and a semantic-red SVG X to cancel in named 44px controls. Board lists use 60% of the base lift, scale/tilt excursion and shadow height/elevation; cards retain their original lift. Timings, live drag coordinates and reduced-motion handling are unchanged.

Project cards place Edit project in Project actions. More places Scheduling in Project tools and keeps only its Manage tools card. Its workspace row reuses the existing compact Projects/Workspaces manager, starting on Workspaces, without a separate side modal.

Performance refinement preserves the approved compositions and motion: date rail pages remain stable through day selection, portfolio/calendar facts avoid repeated work, rejected bulk status changes keep selection for retry, and native reveals cancel pending work on unmount. Source/CPU evidence is not device runtime acceptance.

First-run tour uses the owner-supplied three slides, four starters and geometric TourArtwork, with current theme tokens and existing motion in a centered 520px flow. Preserve Skip/Back, keyboard/focus/retry behavior and in-layer notices. Existing installs replay it through More; only empty storage auto-opens it. Starter creation is one validated operation affecting a new project only.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral Dark and true-black AMOLED, independent of accent preference.
Off-white capsule actions, precise data graphics and a separate work agenda.
Original geometric vector artwork and meaningful status/dependency color.
Adaptive phone and desktop compositions with retained workflow capabilities.

rules.name: The Neutral Canvas Rule
rules.body: Accent preference never tints page backgrounds. Resolve live colors through `palette()`; the legacy accent record's `darkBackground` and `darkCard` fields are not rendering authorities.

rules.name: The Meaningful Color Rule
rules.body: Keep success, warning, danger and information independent of personal accent. Existing task status/priority maps remain separate from chart-series colors; a chart legend must name its own series. Primary buttons invert ink and canvas rather than taking the accent fill.

rules.name: The Readable Numbers Rule
rules.body: Native `CountValue` has intrinsic height with a minimum, allowing system font scaling. Preserve default font scaling and its accessible numeric label; never reinstate a fixed native height/max-height to contain the transition.

dos: **Do** resolve color from the current mode and selected accent through `palette()`.
**Do** keep work, truthful data, calendar selection and gesture feedback visually prominent.
**Do** preserve readable text, named controls, flexible sizing and reduced-motion behavior.
**Do** use the existing platform layout policy and motion primitives before introducing another system.
**Do** review empty, populated, completed, error and selected-date states independently.
donts: **Don't** tint the canvas with the accent, add glow, gradient text or decorative motion loops.
**Don't** use the parent-brand ribbon N, copy competitor artwork or reinstate excluded references.
**Don't** fabricate activity, pre-start sprint history, remote outcomes or evidence of verification.
**Don't** tween live Timeline/Kanban pointer tracking or replace an inline date flow with an unrelated date convention.
**Don't** treat source fixtures or passing contrast checks as native/runtime acceptance.
